REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
THURSDAY - OCTOBER 3, 2024 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Recreation Services Division, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Recreation Services Division during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to recreation@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1254 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to recreation@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Recreation Services Division no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Recreation Services Division at (562) 916-1254 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments will be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
6.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Commissioner or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

Minutes of September 5, 2024

Reports from Designated Commission Staff Liaison
During this part of the meeting, designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior meeting, including any request by members to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior meeting agenda.
8B.
Reports from Parks and Recreation Commission Members
During this part of the meeting, members may provide brief reports to the community on various matters of interest, including any mandated reports required by AB 1234. Pursuant to the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act and the City of Cerritos Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy, there may be no discussion or action taken on any matters presented during this item or that are not listed on the meeting agenda.
9.
Adjournment

CITY OF CERRITOS
  MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  OCTOBER 3, 2024

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.
2.  Pledge of Allegiance
  Commissioner Patnaik led in the Pledge of Allegiance.
3.  Roll Call

  PRESENT:  Commissioner Steve Lin
  Commissioner Pat Patnaik
  Chair Pino Pathak

  ABSENT:  Commissioner David Albright
  Vice Chair Ileana Prado

  All Membersof the Parksand RecreationCommissionwere declared present except
  Commissioner Albright and Vice Chair Prado, whose absenceswere excused.
4.  Presentations
4A.  Presentations

  On behalf of the Parks and Recreation Commission, Chair Pathak recognized
  Employees of the Month for the Recreation Services Division for August, Senior Guard
  Nathan Riddle, Recreation Leader IV Swim Instructor/Lifeguards Aivan Nugyen, Joseph
  Macias,Adrian Buenrostro and Recreation Leader II Jane Jung.

5.  Public Comments and Suggestions
  Recreation Division Superintendent Sherr6 Titus reported receiving no written
  correspondencefrom the public regarding this item.

  Teddy Lloyd presented an update regarding location of pickleball courts; reported
  Councilmember Barrows suggested the Southern California Edison easement near
  Liberty Park and asked him to look into it; noted another idea was at Don Knabe
  Regional Park and the Cerritos Sports Complex and offered to follow up.

  There were no other public comments.
6.  Consent Calendar

6A.  Approval of Minutes – September 5, 2024, 7:00 p.m. Parks and Recreation
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes
   MOTION: Commissioner Patnaik moved to approve the Consent Calendar, as
  presented. Chair Pathaksecondedthe motion, which carried, 3-0, with Commissioner
  Albright and Vice Chair Prado, absent.
7.  New and Old Business
7A.  Reviewand consideration, pursuant to the City of Cerritos commission and committee
  scopeof authority (policy 6.02), of a Commissioner’ssuggestionfor a commission-
  initiated special evaluation project of a proposalfor a schooltree planting initiative in
  Cerritos pars.

  Ms. Titus provided details of the Agenda Report and noted recommendations.

  Discussion followed and clarification was provided by the Chair. Next steps were
  outlined.

  There were no public comments on this item.

  MOTION: Chair Pathak moved to approve Option 1, as listed in the agenda report.
  CommissionerPatnaiksecondedthe motion, which carried, 3-0, with Commissioner
  Albright and Vice Chair Prado, absent.

8.  Reports
8A.  Reports from Designated Commission Staff Liaison

  Recreation Services Supervisor Jill Toda provided an update on Recreation Services
  programs, classes and activities.

  Senior Services Supervisor Jesse Zavala provided an update on Senior Services
  programs, classes and activities.

  Discussion followed regarding the upcoming Senior Center Wellness Fair.

8B.  Reports from Parks and Recreation Commission Members

  There were no reports from the Commissionon this item.
9.  Adjournment
  The meeting was adjourned at 7:35 p.m.

  /s/ Sherr6 Titus
  Sherr6 Titus
